name: Wellnify
summary: Wellnify lets an organization launch wellness challenges and deliver its own or Wellnify's evidence-informed wellness content, with built-in analytics on participation. The vendor publishes no price, and its only calls to action are a demo request and an email contact.

facts.text: The homepage says organizations can launch challenges, deliver content and build wellness experiences without custom development.
The homepage says clients can use Wellnify's evidence-informed wellness content, their own resources, or a combination of both.
The homepage lists analytics dashboard among what the platform provides. An image on the page is described as a community wellness dashboard showing participation and engagement data.
The homepage shows no price. The calls to action are Book a Demo and an email contact.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.unit: not stated on the vendor's site
plans.notes: The vendor publishes no price. Pricing is available on request only.

hiddenCosts: The vendor publishes no price, so no amount is recorded. The participation evidence rests on an analytics listing and an image description, so confirm a sample report before buying.
